bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, wrote Python functions to parse provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries for research abstracts, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, joined research abstract document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
In a supervised individual project, implemented reusable Python modules for the company report metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins for provided company report metadata tables with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.

As an individual contribution to supervised team research, implemented reusable Python modules for the public policy excerpt workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries for public policy excerpts, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins for public policy excerpt data with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
